import json,collections
items=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]
a=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
a[52]['slots']['1']='ь'
open('answers.jsonl','w').writelines(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n' for x in a)
assert len(items)==len(a)
for i,r in zip(items,a):
 assert i['item_id']==r['item_id']
 expected={str(k) for k in range(1,i['slots']+1)}
 assert set(r['slots'])==expected
 assert set(r['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in r['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in r['confidence'].values())
 assert r['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
 assert isinstance(r['unmarked_final_hard_signs'],list)
c=collections.Counter(v for r in a for v in r['slots'].values())
print('Verified count, order, and slot coverage:',len(a),'items;',sum(c.values()),'slots')
print({k:c[k] for k in ['ъ','ь','other','u']})
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(r['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for r in a))
